title: State holds the state of nine subsystems in fifty fields
body:
`State` in `compositor.rs` has about fifty fields. Beside the smithay `*_state` fields, which the delegate macros need on the handler type, they group like this:

| group | fields |
|---|---|
| viewers | `viewers`, `next_viewer`, `active` |
| selection mirror | `offered` |
| channel clients | `sockets`, `next_client` |
| children | `env`, `children` |
| rendering | `gpu`, `rounded`, `font`, `menu_font`, `texts`, `size`, `scale`, `wants_redraw`, `render_failing` |
| overlays | `menu`, `panel`, `picker`, `picker_tick` |
| input | `pointer`, `drag`, `repeat`, `repeating`, `ctrl_timer`, `cursor` |
| persistence | `settings`, `settings_path`, `save_path`, `save_due` |
| workspaces | `workspaces`, `next_workspace`, `unplaced`, `sidebar_open` |

About seventy methods each touch one or two groups, and nothing in a signature says which. Clippy's `struct_excessive_bools` fires on `State` and on `Viewer`.

## Proposal

Split out the groups that already have their own methods, one at a time, starting where other issues already want a home: the overlay enum, the text and font home, the viewer frame pool, the child spawner. The smithay fields stay on `State`.

## Open

Which groups earn a struct and which are two fields that happen to sit together. The input group may stay flat.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/913b1d2c
notes.text:
What this phase took off `State`:

- `env` and `children` became `Children` in `children.rs` (ec48420).
- `bar` and `hover` moved from every `Layout` onto `State`, and the drag cell into `Drag::Pane` (e093411).
- The methods moved into modules under `src/compositor/` by job (fe90d27): `viewers.rs`, `input.rs`, `channels.rs`, `selection.rs` and `render.rs`. The fields stayed on `State`, and each module reaches them as a child of `compositor`.

Left for the issues that already own them:

| group | issue |
|---|---|
| `menu`, `panel`, `picker`, `picker_tick` | decade-fbc2df |
| `font`, `menu_font`, `texts` | decade-e5e569 |
| `workspaces`, `next_workspace`, `unplaced`, `sidebar_open` | decade-701a8d, decade-2f1c63 |

Kept as plain fields: the viewers (`viewers`, `next_viewer`, `active`), the channel clients (`sockets`, `next_client`), persistence (`settings`, `settings_path`, `save_path`, `save_due`) and input (`repeat`, `repeating`, `pointer`, `drag`, `ctrl_timer`). The methods that read each group also read other groups, so a struct around one would lengthen every access without taking a method off `State`. `size` and `scale` stay too; see decade-e8e0f0.
